experiment_data.hypothesis: occ_detach=true cuts gradient flow from occ head to vision encoder. If CAR improvement disappears compared to full occ (occ_detach=false), it proves the benefit comes from representation learning (gradient-based encoder adaptation) rather than mere regularization effect of the auxiliary loss. This validates Claim 3 (Gradient Flow Necessity). Seed 43 replication of ablation_occ_detach_s0.
